leg_links.method: Synapses from leg i's premotor cells (of the given sign) onto leg j's premotor cells, plus 0.1 x the two-step paths through any interneuron. Premotor pools as in this builder.

selection: The optogenetics circuit plus, per leg, the top 60 premotor interneurons (>= 10 synapses onto its motor neurons); the top 200 interneurons reaching premotor cells or motor neurons of two or more leg segments (>= 10 synapses each); P9's two-step route to front-leg premotor cells and motor neurons (>= 5); mirror completion. All positive edges among selected cells. Chemical synapses only.
